settings.name_in_paper: Incentivized Exploration with Stochastic Rewards (infinite arms in a metric space, reward drift)
unmapped: Incentivized exploration: a principal recommends arms to myopic greedy agents and pays compensation kappa_t = hat mu(g_t) - hat mu(a_t); total compensation is a second objective
Reward drift: observed reward r_t = rho_t(a_t) + gamma_t(kappa_t) with gamma_t non-decreasing, gamma_t(0)=0, ell_t-Lipschitz (biased feedback)
Complexity measured by the covering dimension of the metric arm space
settings.definition_quote: We consider a variant of the multi-armed bandit problem with an uncountable set of arms $A$, structured as a metric space $(A, \Phi)$ ... its reward is independently drawn from a probability distribution supported on $[0,1]$ with mean $\mu(a)$ ... $|\mu(a) - \mu(a')| \leq L \cdot \Phi(a, a')$ ... the principal introduces a compensation \(\kappa_t\), modifying the observed reward to $r_t = \rho_t(a_t) + \gamma_t(\kappa_t),$

settings.name_in_paper: Incentivized Exploration with Contextual Information (contextual Lipschitz bandits, reward drift)
unmapped: Incentivized exploration with compensation paid to myopic agents; total compensation is a second objective
Reward drift r_t = rho_t(a_t) + gamma_t(kappa_t), gamma_t non-decreasing, ell_t-Lipschitz
Reward nu(a,x) Lipschitz w.r.t. sum metric on arm x context space; complexity is covering dimension d = d_a + d_x
Context generation process not specified (contexts treated as given sequence)

source.label: thm-reg-ucb
source.quote: Consider Algorithm~\ref{meta-inc-uniform} run on a metric space \((A, \Phi)\), where arms are discretized using a \(\psi\)-covering \(A_0 \subseteq A\) satisfying \(|A_0| \leq O(1 / \psi^d)\) ... If \(\psi = O(...)\), then the expected regret and compensation satisfy: \mathbb{E}[\mathcal{R}_T] = \Tilde{O}( L^{\frac{d}{d+2}} T^{\frac{d+1}{d+2}} ) ... the hidden constants ... depend on the drift parameter \(\ell\).

results.notes: Regret defined as E[sum (mu* - rho_t(a_t))], mapped to pseudo-regret. Hidden constants depend on drift parameter ell. Proof's psi also depends on ell.
